text:
Old is the night, old,

long is my ancient heart.


How many arms inside

my chest, cold,

move and search for me,

my old love!


The night, old, falls

like a slow martyrdom,

shadow and star, hollow

of my chest.


And meanwhile I, absent

from my martyrdom,

go into the night, searching

for her cold body.


There has been no moon, you fools,

for centuries.

Only a brief miracle

when it is cold.

translation.title: Old Is the Night
